newsitem.title: USA: Unimark wins long-term citrus contract.
newsitem.headline: Unimark wins long-term citrus contract.

text.p: The UniMark Group Inc said on Thursday its Mexican subsidiary entered into a long-term supply contract to plant and grow about 12,000 acres of citrus, expanding its agricultural operations in Mexico.
Its Grupo Industrial Santa Engracia, a Mexican producer of citrus concentrates, citrus oils and citrus juices, expected to begin developing this citrus plantation immediately, the copmany said.
The name of the company being supplied was not disclosed.
Jorn Budde, chief executive officer, said: "This arrangement will significantly expand our agricultural operations in Mexico."
The UniMark Group, Inc is a vertically integrated citrus and tropical fruit growing, processing, marketing and distribution company with operations in Mexico, the United States and Canada.
